LanguageData.LP_HellsLegion.label: infernal legion
LanguageData.LP_HellsLegion.description: The regular army of the Nine Hells: chain devils, bone devils, horned devils and erinyes. They come to collect debts and catch those in breach of contract, and fight the abyssal horde in the tide of the Blood War. Mutually hostile with the abyssal horde.
LanguageData.LP_HellsLegion.ideoDescription: Order is contract, and contract is everything.
LanguageData.LP_FeyHunt.label: wild hunt
LanguageData.LP_FeyHunt.description: The hunting party of the two queens: riders in antlered helms, winter wolves, blink dogs and redcaps. They chase only one prey, until dawn. Mutually hostile with the abyssal horde.
LanguageData.LP_FeyHunt.ideoDescription: When the moon rises, the prey had better run.
LanguageData.LP_HellsBrokers.label: infernal broker
LanguageData.LP_HellsBrokers.description: A band of trading devil lawyers and their bone devil guards. They sell contracts, soul coins and demonology tomes, and buy prisoners and souls; people dragged into the Nine Hells by them can also be ransomed back from them. Whoever dares rob their caravans, the Nine Hells will remember forever.
LanguageData.LP_HellsBrokers.ideoDescription: Everything can be traded; everything must be signed.
LanguageData.LP_FeyCourt.label: fey court
LanguageData.LP_FeyCourt.description: Fey merchants who come out of the two queens' courts to trade: they set up stalls when the moon rises and pack up before dawn. They don't take silver as payment; they take memories, years of life, names and laughter.
LanguageData.LP_FeyCourt.ideoDescription: Everything has a price; it's just not always silver.
LanguageData.LP_PlanarTruce.label: temporary truce
LanguageData.LP_PlanarTruce.description: The side in the tide of the Blood War that accepted the colony's help: neutral toward you this time, leaving once the fighting is over.
